Overview of Canton of Vaud Region (Vaud)

Canton of Vaud Region (Vaud) is located in the Canton of Vaud region of Switzerland, with its prefectural capital at Lausanne. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Château de Chillon & Montreux Riviera, Lavaux UNESCO Vineyard Terraces, Lausanne Olympic Museum & Cathedral, Glacier 3000 & Villars-sur-Ollon.

RegionCanton of Vaud
Capital cityLausanne
Cities & municipalities47
Primary transport hubLausanne Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)

How to get to Canton of Vaud Region

40 minutes from Geneva Airport along the Lake Geneva SBB mainline via Lausanne, Vevey and Montreux. Use our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Canton of Vaud

When visiting cities across Canton of Vaud, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Papet Vaudois
  • Filets de perche du Léman
  • Malakoff fried cheese
  • Lavaux Chasselas wines
  • Gruyère & Etivaz alpine cheeses

Best time to visit Canton of Vaud

Best time to visit Canton of Vaud: May–Oct.
